title: Broke after 4 days
text: Broke after 4 days. Was super excited when I got this because it is soft as can be. It heated up quickly and entirely. Score! 4 days later and all it does flash a red light. Unplugging it, restarting, nothing helps. Super disappointed and also annoyed that now I have to go through the trouble of returning.

product_metadata.title: Homde Heated Electric Throw 50 Inch x 60 Inch Reversible Flannel/Sherpa Washable Blanket with 3-Heat Setting Auto-Off Controller for Bed or Couch (Brown & White)
features: SAFETY ASSURANCE: Homde safe heated throw is certificated by ETL. Shuts off automatically after 4 hours of continuous use, no worry of forgotten shutoff. Overheat protection promotes safer use experience. Also, we offer a two-year guarantee to put your mind at ease. NOTE : The suitable voltage is 120V AC only / 60Hz

EASY TO USE: Controller is easy to see and use, and features 3 warming settings (rang: 90-110℉), you can choose the right warmth for yourself. 10 feet power cable makes the electric heated blanket free of restriction by a short cable to work flexibly in a wider range; Can also be used as a normal blanket by simply detaching the controller

FULL BODY COMFORT: Size: 50’’ x 60’’. With flannel face and sherpa (shu velveteen) reverse, Homde heated throw blanket is comfy and cozy, and can gently wraps you in warmth and comfort during cold nights. High quality heated wire is used, heating quickly and evenly. Great gift for Men and Women; Moms and Dads; Valentine’s, Mother’s and Father’s Day; Christmas and New Year

MACHINE WASHABLE & DRYER SAFE: The electric blanket is machine washable and dryer safe after the controller is detachable. It’s easy to maintain hygienic and soft use of this electric warming blanket for years to come

MULTI USE:Elegant appearance match any décor in your home. 50’’ x 60’’ throw blanket is perfect for the couch, chair and bed as an extra layer- Suitable for indoor and outdoor use to provide consecutive warmth in chilly weather, especially for camping and picnic
